root_cause: The context-load diet and narrowed Gate C watchdog prompts preserved the current handoff edge but dropped the global provider-role invariant that existed in earlier orchestration state. Local/phone QAIRT source scans were then treated as sufficient to route user source custody before the authorized RunPod surface was checked.
bad_inference_prevented: host/phone-local artifact absence does not imply user_action_required when the provider matrix lists an authorized provider surface for that artifact class.

runpod.role: QAIRT/QNN SDK source/tool host for outside-git export/build metadata
runpod.safe_check: metadata-only SSH check against the matrix-listed RunPod access surface; do not print secrets or move raw payloads

phone_adb_termux.role: RedMagic 10 Pro authority execution target for model/training gates
phone_adb_termux.safe_check: ADB state plus scoped Termux/SSH metadata checks only inside an authorized recovery or execution route

hugging_face.role: corpus/model revision source and metadata-only provenance
hugging_face.safe_check: hf auth whoami after approved env sourcing; report account/org status only

github.safe_check: gh auth status and git remote metadata with token redaction

comet.safe_check: authorized SDK init or auth check that does not print COMET_API_KEY

false_stop_prevention: Do not mark user_action_required merely because host/phone-local scans missed an artifact; check the provider matrix first.
Do not route source custody to the user until all authorized provider surfaces for that artifact class have been checked or have exact auth failure evidence.
Do not call provider absence a BLOCKER unless an authorized safe check failed or the required access surface is genuinely missing.
Keep RunPod and phone roles distinct: RunPod is the QAIRT/QNN SDK source/tool host; the RedMagic phone is the model/training authority execution target.
Classify Hugging Face, GitHub, and Comet for every relevant edge so dataset/model provenance, custody commits, and authority-linked metrics do not drift out of memory.
provider_capability_capsule.secret_policy: Never print, copy, summarize, commit, or include token/key values.

control_surface_changes.change: Provider capability capsule made mandatory for provider/source/logging/custody-affected routes.
NEXT_HANDOFF schema now carries provider_capability_capsule and invalidates premature user_action_required for provider/source-custody gaps.
Context-load rule now requires a targeted provider matrix extract for affected routes.
Repo-level ZPP PRD now includes provider capability capsule rules and RunPod/phone role separation.
Linter now flags provider/source/logging/custody routes that omit provider_capability_capsule.
Tests added for QAIRT source-custody/provider route drift.
